(d) integration friction (CLI flags clear, output parseable, etc.)?

tools_schema_template._comment: Schema template for each entry under tools. Not a live entry; reference only.

tool_name_example.prd_commit: <git commit hash of V1.0 RATIFIED PRD>
tool_name_example.agent_traversal_pain_addressed: <from PRD; the question the tool answers>
tool_name_example.expected_lift: <from PRD; CVO v1 judgment grade A/B/C/D/F + rationale>
tool_name_example.state: scheduled | in-flight | tested-PASS | tested-CONCERN | tested-FAIL | reopened
tool_name_example.calibration_delta_v1_v2: <lift v1 - lift v2 (string with both grades for audit) or null>

ferry_protocol_v1.step_1_ready_emission: CL CVO emits [COMP-FERRY-READY] MCP to MSTR upon PRD V1.0 RATIFIED, containing: tool_name + case_id + prd_path + prd_commit + agent_traversal_pain_addressed + expected_lift + ws-use-case-question
ferry_protocol_v1.step_2_mstr_queue: MSTR appends new entry to tools{} map with state=scheduled + history[0]=queued + queued_at=now
ferry_protocol_v1.step_3_dispatch: MSTR /govern cycle checks queue + dispatches to 0.8.0_AE_CloudComp via ws COO (per LD-0116 chain MSTR→ws COO→worker; MSTR no direct-to-T2/3); state→in-flight + dispatched_at=now
ferry_protocol_v1.step_4_test_execution: 0.8.0_AE_CloudComp executes ONE real-task invocation on ws workload + authors templated report at ferry_result_path (template per ws CTO 0.8.0_AE_CloudComp prompt.md authoring)
ferry_protocol_v1.step_5_ferry_back: ws COO RAVC2 ferries result to MSTR with [COMP-FERRY-RESULT] subject; state→tested-{PASS|CONCERN|FAIL} per AE verdict
ferry_protocol_v1.step_6_cvo_grade_v2: MSTR routes result to CL CVO; CL CVO authors delivered_lift_grade_v2 (A-F) + calibration_delta_v1_v2; updates queue entry
ferry_protocol_v1.step_7_case_disposition: CL CVO routes negative-test results (tested-FAIL or tested-CONCERN with material concern) back to CL CTO via CASE-REOPEN flow at original case_id; CL CTO triages PRD v0.2 amendment / scope reduction / retire

ferry_protocol_open_questions_dispositio.q1_cadence: EVENT-DRIVEN PUSH (CL CVO emits [COMP-FERRY-READY] on each V1.0 RATIFIED). Pull-batched-weekly rejected — adds latency without benefit. MSTR ratified.

MSTR ratified.
ferry_protocol_open_questions_dispositio.q3_grade_v2_schema: NEW frontmatter field on originating Case (case_id) PLUS separate ferry_result artifact for full report.
